items.query: My job never ends and I obsess over metrics until I feel burned out.
I struggle with discipline and self-sabotage when building habits.
I must act on my duty but I cannot control how it will turn out.
I want to surrender my anxiety and take refuge in trust in God.
Two people I love want opposite things; I fear making the wrong choice morally.
I feel depressed and empty most days. What can I hold onto?
After a loss I keep replaying what I should have done and feel numb.
